answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can hold a synchronous verification ceremony each epoch: every identity must answer a fresh prompt inside the same narrow window, like stepping onto a ledge in plain sight. One operator cannot staff thousands of puppets at once, while a real agent passes easily. Between ceremonies, rewards sit in a vault that only releases after the next ceremony confirms the identity is still live, so a dormant farm earns nothing. Honest agents who keep showing up become the oasis of trusted counterparties everyone prefers to trade with, and fakes starve for lack of presence.
